name_en: Derive the canvas from the destination
what: لا تسأل «أي مقاس؟» بل «أين سيُعرض؟» واشتق الإطار وسجّل الاشتقاق في البريف. / Derive the canvas from where it plays and record the derivation in the brief.
how: Reels/TikTok/Shorts/Snapchat/WhatsApp status → 9:16 1080×1920; YouTube/site/desktop → 16:9 1920×1080; feed reach → 4:5 1080×1350; square feed → 1:1 1080×1080; link preview → 1.91:1 1200×630; Pinterest → 2:3 1000×1500; cinema → 2.39:1. Fastify planner sets 9:16 by default and render.py forces even widths (width=round(h*ratio)); beware `--height 1920` on 16:9 gives 3413×1920, so pass `--height 1080`. KOSIF scaffolds declare the target per composition.

name_en: Aspect presets across the owner tools
what: كل أدواتك تتفق على نفس الجدول: 9:16 و16:9 و1:1 و4:5، مع 4:3 و21:9 في التحقق والمونتاج. / All owner tools share one ratio table; verify_video also accepts 4:3 and 21:9.
how: `kosif.py scaffold <id> <dir>` and `verify_video.py --aspect`; kosif-studio RATIOS add 4:3 1440×1080 and 21:9 2520×1080; claude-animation-studio `new_scene.py --ratio 9:16 --dur 10 --fps 30 --kind 2d|3d`; studio forms offer fps 24/25/30/50/60. Basma editor works at 720p (9:16 720×1280, 1:1 900×900, 16:9 1280×720, 4:5 864×1080) and exports with short side 1080; it auto-picks the aspect from the source ratio (>1.2 → 16:9, <0.7 → 9:16, <0.9 → 4:5, else 1:1). Verified here: verify_video passed 11/12 on a 9:16 platform file (loudness check failed on a sine tone, as expected).

what: إما ترندر مباشرة بإطار عريض (1920×816) أو تضع أشرطة سوداء داخل 16:9، وأحيانًا تنفتح الأشرطة في أول اللقطة. / Render a native 1920×816 frame, or burn black bars inside 16:9; optionally animate the bars open.
how: Bar height = (H − W/2.39)/2 → 138 px at 1080p, 92 px at 720p (≈12–12.5% each). Burn with two drawbox fills; place subtitles inside the lower bar. Animated reveal (scene3d template): #letterbox-top/bottom from 70 px → 0 over 2.2 s power4.inOut, starting at min(2.4 s, 15% of D). Compose subjects on thirds with wide negative space. Verified here with drawbox on 1920×1080. (code snippet in references/powers/formats-platforms.md)
params: bars 138 px @1080p · 92 px @720p · reveal 70→0 px / 2.2 s

name_en: Fixed stage scaled as one block
what: صمّم كل إطار على 1920×1080 ثابت وكبّر المسرح كله للنافذة بدل إعادة التدفق. / Author on a fixed 1920×1080 stage and scale the whole stage to the viewport instead of reflowing.
how: .stage{width:1920px;height:1080px;transform:scale(min(vw/1920, vh/1080))} with letter/pillarbox; keep all chrome inside the stage; switch slides with opacity/visibility not display; no breakpoints inside the stage. For video renders this equals fixed px layout per data-width/height on #root.

what: تكوين واحد يُصدَّر إلى 16:9 و9:16 و1:1 بأحجام خط مشتقة من عرض الإطار. / One composition exports to 16:9, 9:16 and 1:1 with type sized from the frame width.
how: Size tokens per aspect, or clamp()/vw against the composition width (not the browser). Minimums at 1080 wide: body/caption ≥ 48–64 px on 9:16, smallest legible 36 px; split content rather than shrinking it.

name_en: Deliberate vertical vs horizontal data layouts
what: لا تضغط رسمًا أفقيًا في إطار عمودي؛ صمّم نسخة رأسية بعلامات أقل وعناوين أقصر. / Design vertical and horizontal versions of a data scene instead of squeezing the desktop chart.
how: 9:16: fewer markers, shorter labels, stacked small multiples, legend below, 3–5 ticks. 16:9: side-by-side panels, 4–7 ticks. Map plates 3840×2160 for 16:9 and ≈2700×3840 for 9:16. Inspect rendered pixels at every ratio (see DATA, MAP families).

what: نماذج الانتشار تريد أبعادًا تقبل القسمة على 8 أو 16 أو 32، وLTX يريد 8k+1 إطارًا. / Diffusion models need sizes divisible by 8/16/32 and LTX needs 8k+1 frames.
how: Round W/H to ÷8 (SD), ÷16 (Wan, Krea 2), ÷32 (LTX); LTX common 768×512, 1216×704, 704×480 with 121/161/257 frames; frames = round_to_8k+1(duration×fps). Then upscale/reframe to the delivery canvas, never stretch. AI clip slot lengths used by Fastify profiles: 6 s (fitness, viral), 7 s (stickman), 8 s Veo / 10 s Flow (kinetic), 10 s (vox, food) — re-verify model availability.

what: في 1080×1920 تغطي أزرار المنصة الأعلى والأسفل والجانب الأيمن؛ ضع النص والوجوه والدعوة داخل ≈900×1350 مزاحة للأعلى. / On 1080×1920 platform chrome covers top, bottom and right rail; keep critical content in a ~900×1350 zone nudged upward.
how: Conservative margins: top 250, bottom 320, right 120, left 60 px (IG story/reel covers: avoid 250 top / 400 bottom; rule of thumb: UI covers bottom 20% and right 12%). Owner variants: kosif-tool starter safe overlay inset 120/60/220 px (checkbox #safe, verified in the canvas starter), Basma review rule top 14% / bottom 18% (25–35% in its director KB) / sides 6% with captions ≈70% down; tool-briefs use 120 px top/bottom. Values drift with app updates — draw guides first, screenshot-check.
params: T250 B320 R120 L60 · trusted ≈900×1350 · starter inset 120/60/220

what: مقاسات الصور الثابتة والأغلفة مع الهامش الآمن لكل سطح. / Still/cover sizes with text-safe margins per surface.
how: LinkedIn post 1200×627 (100 px) · X card 1200×675 (80 px) · IG square 1080×1080 (108 px = 10%) · IG landscape 1080×566 (80 px) · FB post 1200×630 (100 px) · YouTube thumbnail 1280×720 (72 px) · channel art 2560×1440 (safe 1546×423 centred) · LinkedIn cover 1584×396 · X header 1500×500 · GitHub preview 1280×640 ≤1 MB · display 300×250, 728×90, 160×600. Keep key content 10–15% from edges.

what: الترجمة داخل title-safe 90% وبعيدة عن واجهة المنصة، سطران كحد أقصى. / Captions inside 90% title-safe, clear of platform UI, max two lines.
how: 5% margins; on 9:16 keep out of bottom ≈20% and right ≈12%; position ≈70% down; ≤2 lines; contrast ≥4.5:1 (≥7:1 for small mobile text).

what: أصغر نص 36 بكسل على عرض 1080، فحص على معاينة 360 بكسل، تباين ≥4.5:1. / Smallest text 36 px at 1080 wide, checked on a 360 px preview, contrast ≥4.5:1.
how: kosif-tool STYLE.md §6 + TEST_REPORT: sides 5%, top/bottom 12% on 9:16; Basma wraps every agent run on 9:16 so caption.size < 9 becomes 9.5 and missing stroke becomes 6; montage-motion readable() rule passes its test (`test_launch.Rules.test_readable`).
params: min 36 px @1080 · preview 360 px · Basma caption ≥9.5, stroke 6

what: المحتوى المروي فكرة واحدة في الإطار بخط ضخم، والمقروء صامتًا يحتمل بنية أكثر؛ قسّم بدل أن تصغّر. / Narrated pieces carry one idea per frame; silent read-first pieces can hold more — split rather than shrink.
how: Ask: narrated or silent? Speaker-led: 1–3 bullets; reading-first: 4–8 bullets or 4–6 cards. Social autoplays muted, so burn the key words or ship captions.vtt.

what: تحويل أي لقطة لنسبة أخرى يتبع الوجوه (ومركز الحركة عند غيابها)، أو قص المنتصف، أو صورة فوق خلفية ضبابية. / Reframe to another ratio following faces (motion-centroid fallback), centre crop, or fit over a blurred fill.
how: `python3 scripts/kmotion.py aspect CLIP --to 9:16|16:9|1:1|4:5 --mode smart|crop|blur --out v.mp4` (same tool in kosif-studio `motion/tools.py aspect`, studio recipe "aspect", MCP kosif_run). Blur mode: gblur sigma 40, brightness −0.12, saturation 0.85. Verified here: 1920×1080 → 4:5 smart gave 1080×1350. Heavier subject tracking (YOLO/mediapipe) is an install away; Resolve Smart Reframe needs Resolve Studio.
params: modes smart|crop|blur · blur σ40, −0.12 brightness, 0.85 sat

name_en: Full frame over its blurred fill
what: اصنع 9:16 من 16:9 بوضع الإطار كاملًا في المنتصف فوق نسخة مكبّرة مموّهة ومعتمة منه. / Make 9:16 from 16:9 by laying the full frame over a scaled, blurred, darkened copy of itself.
how: Verified here on 1920×1080 → 1080×1920. Variants: gblur sigma 30 instead of boxblur; HyperFrames yt-vertical-fill block does the reverse (portrait inside 16:9 with blurred/mirror/copy side fills, grid texture, contrast lift; `npx hyperframes add yt-vertical-fill`). (code snippet in references/powers/formats-platforms.md)

what: أدخل أي مصدر في إطار الهدف بلا تشويه: تصغير وحشو (letter/pillarbox)، أو قص المنتصف عندما يكون الموضوع في الوسط فعلًا. / Fit any source without distortion: scale down and pad, or centre-crop only when the subject really is centred.
how: Pad: scale=W:H:force_original_aspect_ratio=decrease,pad=W:H:(ow-iw)/2:(oh-ih)/2. Centre crop: crop=ih*9/16:ih,scale=1080:1920 (pro-video-editor edl_render `--ratios 9:16,1:1`). Never pad with plain black for social — prefer the blurred fill.

name_ar: أوضاع ملاءمة اللقطة: cover / contain / blur
name_en: Clip fit modes cover · contain · blur
what: اللقطات البديلة تُقص وتُطابق سرعتها وتثبّت إطاراتها ثم تُلائم الإطار بالتغطية أو الاحتواء أو الخلفية الضبابية بعدد إطارات اللقطة بالضبط. / Replacement clips are trimmed, speed-matched, set to CFR and fitted by cover/contain/blur to the exact shot frame count.
how: Timeline JSON `clips[].fit = cover|contain|blur`; mimic `shots[i].replacement.fit` → mm_build._fit_filter / prep_shot. Found-footage normaliser (Ghorba): -ss 0 -t DUR -an, scale=W:H:force_original_aspect_ratio=increase:flags=bicubic,crop=W:H,setsar=1,fps=24,<grade>,format=yuv420p, libx264 crf 24 -threads 2, -stream_loop -1 for clips shorter than the slot.

name_en: Batch vertical shorts from a long edit
what: من تايملاين طويل اقترح ≈20 مرشحًا بخطافات مختلفة وتوقيتات دخول وخروج دقيقة، ثم نسخ عمودية بتأطير يتبع الموضوع. / Propose ~20 short candidates with distinct hooks and exact in/out from a long timeline, then reframe each to portrait.
how: Feasibility: a 60 s short with two 15 s handles needs ≥90 s of source. Local path: per candidate ffmpeg trim + kmotion aspect --mode smart (or blur), inspect frames; never pad black or silently shorten. Resolve path: duplicate timeline, custom 2160×3840 before switching to portrait, Smart Reframe per clip (Resolve Studio scripting), verify the render really is 2160×3840 — API success ≠ good framing.

what: رندر الماستر بأكبر نسبة ثم أعد تكوين كل منصة (مواضع النص والعناصر) ويمر كل ملف من بوابة الفحص. / Render the master at the largest aspect, recompose each platform version and gate each file.
how: For HTML motion, re-render each ratio from the same composition with ratio-specific layout tokens (text blocks, legends) instead of cropping pixels; for product/feature videos reframe each ratio against the real UI and make one poster per ratio. Native portrait renders of every AI clip cost ≈2× (scroll-world clipMobile chain, 720 w, -g 4); a focus-x % per stop can steer a cheaper 16:9→9:16 crop.
license: mcp-higgsfield-landing has no licence file — read for ideas, do not copy code.

name_ar: نسخ الصور متعددة المقاسات بخدمة Adobe
what: من صورة واحدة نسخ لكل منصة بقص يتبع الموضوع أو توسيع بالذكاء، بمعاينة 3 قصّات أولًا. / Platform crops from one image with subject-aware crop or generative expand, previewing 3 crops first.
how: Adobe Firefly connector: image_crop_and_resize / video_resize (video is resize only, no auto-reframe), focus subject|face|upper_body|{prompt}|{x,y}. Local equivalent: saliency/face box → crop, or blurred/mirrored fill.

what: كل MP4 للويب 8-bit 4:2:0، وذرة moov في المقدمة ليبدأ التشغيل قبل اكتمال التحميل، وعلامات BT.709 حتى لا يبهت اللون على iOS. / Every web/social MP4 is 8-bit 4:2:0, moov-first and tagged BT.709 so iOS/QuickTime do not wash colours out.
how: Verified here: bt709 tags read back by ffprobe and moov before mdat. Owner encoders: kosif-studio film.Encoder pipes RGB into libx264 and raises if ffmpeg exits non-zero (draft ultrafast/crf 23, delivery medium/crf 18, GOP 2×fps); fastify render.py CRF 19; kosif-tool render-pipeline H.264 High CRF 18–20; kosif-studio tools gate: even dimensions, AAC 48 kHz 192–256k. (code snippet in references/powers/formats-platforms.md)
params: crf 17–18 final / 23 web · AAC 160–320k 48 kHz · GOP 2×fps

what: 3840×2160 بإطارات التايملاين، H.264 بـ 45 Mbps (≤30 fps) أو 68 Mbps (60 fps)، وصوت AAC 320k. / 3840×2160 at timeline fps, H.264 45/68 Mbps or H.265 30/45, AAC 48 kHz 320 kbps, −14 LUFS.
how: ffmpeg -c:v libx264 -b:v 45M -maxrate 50M -bufsize 90M; if the NLE lacks AAC, render PCM then -c:v copy -c:a aac -b:a 320k; verify frame count within 1 frame of the timeline; −14 LUFS ±1, TP ≤ −1 dBTP. Vector scenes can be re-rendered at 4K (HyperFrames `--resolution landscape-4k` via deviceScaleFactor; kosif-studio `studio.py SCENE --render out.png --scale 3.2` = 3840×2560, raster results enlarged by integer Lanczos with unsharp 1.35/−0.35).

what: صدّر الطبقات (شريط اسم، ملصق، شعار) بشفافية لتركيبها في محرر آخر أو على صفحة. / Export overlays with alpha for NLEs (ProRes 4444 .mov) or the web (VP9 .webm).
how: Verified here: VP9 yuva420p reports alpha_mode=1; prores_ks -profile:v 4444 writes yuva444p12le. Remotion: --image-format=png --pixel-format=yuva444p10le --codec=prores --prores-profile=4444, or yuva420p + vp9. HyperFrames: render --format webm|mov|png-sequence. The page background must be transparent. (code snippet in references/powers/formats-platforms.md)

what: حافظ على مصادر BT.2020 PQ/HLG في HEVC بعشرة بت. / Keep BT.2020 PQ/HLG sources in 10-bit HEVC MP4.
how: HyperFrames render --hdr (auto when sources are HDR; not combinable with --resolution); verify transfer/primaries with ffprobe. Social defaults stay SDR BT.709.

what: ماستر واحد ← 1080/720/480 بإطارات مفتاحية متطابقة للبث التكيّفي. / One master packaged into 1080/720/480 renditions with aligned keyframes.
how: Verified here: 3 variant playlists + master.m3u8 with 3 STREAM-INF. Gotcha found here: with var_stream_map each rendition needs its own audio map (-map 0:a three times), otherwise ffmpeg fails with "Invalid argument". Choose HLS (widest), DASH, CMAF (one set for both) or LL-HLS/WebRTC for live; DRM and CDN are external. (code snippet in references/powers/formats-platforms.md)

what: ترميز سريع على كرت NVIDIA بإعدادات جودة عالية. / Fast NVIDIA encode with quality flags.
how: -c:v h264_nvenc -preset p7 -tune hq -rc vbr -cq 19; HyperFrames --gpu. This container has no GPU — use libx264.

what: قِس ثم اضبط الكسب إلى الهدف وحدّ القمة الحقيقية. / Measure, gain to the destination target, limit true peak.
how: Web/YouTube/Spotify/Apple −14 LUFS ±1, TP ≤ −1 dBTP; calm pieces −16 to −18; podcast −16 (mono −19); broadcast EBU R128 −23; club −9 to −6 (script −8); music bed under SFX −18 to −20. Two-pass loudnorm I=-14:TP=-1:LRA=11, then confirm with ebur128=peak=true on the encoded file; kosif-tool verify_video prints LUFS and TP (the proof films measured −14.0 LUFS / −2.1 dBFS). Preserve user audio untouched unless asked.

name_en: Loop audio formats & music licence receipts
what: MP3 يضيف صمتًا في الطرفين فيكسر الحلقات؛ سلّم WAV/OGG/Opus، وسجّل ترخيص الموسيقى في إيصال الرندر. / MP3 pads silence and breaks loops — ship WAV/OGG/Opus; record music rights in the render receipt.
how: ffmpeg -c:a libopus or pcm_s16le; browsers need Web Audio buffer loop. ElevenLabs free plan has no commercial licence and needs "Eleven Music" credit; paid plan licence counts at render time — store plan/rights in the receipt.

what: معاينات iOS: حتى 3، من 15 إلى 30 ث، ≤500 MB، لقطات التطبيق الحقيقية فقط، وأول 5 ث تحسم. / iOS previews: up to 3, 15–30 s, ≤500 MB, real app footage only; the first 5 s decide.
how: H.264 10–12 Mbps up to 30 fps (or ProRes 422 HQ), stereo AAC 256 kbps at 44.1/48 kHz, .mov/.m4v/.mp4, autoplays muted; average watch 4–6.5 s. Google Play takes a YouTube URL. ffmpeg -c:v libx264 -b:v 11M -maxrate 12M -r 30 -c:a aac -b:a 256k -ar 48000 -ac 2; verify with ffprobe.

what: فيديو الويب muted autoplay playsinline loop بصورة poster، وWebM مع بديل H.264، وفرع لمن يفضل تقليل الحركة. / Ship web video muted/playsinline/loop with a poster, WebM + H.264 fallback and a prefers-reduced-motion branch.
how: Poster via -frames:v 1 is the LCP image; explicit width/height or aspect-ratio; stills as <picture> AVIF → WebP → JPEG at 3–5 widths; fetchpriority high on 1–2 hero images. Owner light profile (earth): WebP q80 at 1600/1200/900 widths, silent H.264 1280 w crf 27 -an +faststart (~1.8 MB of brand art, tested).
params: LCP ≤2.5 s · CLS <0.1 · INP <200 ms · WebP q80 · crf 27

name_ar: تسجيل المتصفح إلى MP4 وGIF بمرورين
what: سجّل حركة الواجهة بمقاس فيديو صريح، احتفظ بالـ WebM، حوّل إلى MP4، ولا تصنع GIF إلا إذا بقي التوقيت مفهومًا. / Record UI motion at an explicit video size, keep the WebM, convert to MP4, GIF only when timing survives.
how: Playwright video:{mode:"on", size:{width:1280,height:820}} (Playwright + Chromium installed here); ffmpeg -vf scale=1280:-2 -c:v libx264 -pix_fmt yuv420p -crf 26 -preset veryfast -movflags +faststart -an; GIF fps=12,scale=960:-1:flags=lanczos,palettegen → paletteuse.

what: ملف لكل منصة بنسبتها ومقاسها وسقف معدل البت، مع تقرير المدة والحجم دون قص صامت. / One checked file per platform at its ratio, size and bitrate ceiling; duration/size limits reported, never trimmed.
how: `python3 scripts/kmotion.py platforms FILM.mp4 --out deliver --platforms tiktok,reels,shorts,youtube,x,whatsapp,linkedin,snapchat --mode smart|crop|blur --title …` → FILM_<platform>.mp4 + FILM.platforms.json (libx264 high, CRF 20, maxrate, faststart, AAC 48k). Verified here on a 6 s clip (tiktok/whatsapp/youtube + JSON with warnings) and by test_platforms_table. Limits are "as commonly published; verify at use".

name_ar: حزمة التسليم: كل النسب وغلاف وGIF
name_en: Delivery pack: all ratios + poster + GIF/WebP
what: من ماستر واحد: نسخة لكل نسبة (بتأطير ذكي ومتوازي)، غلاف JPG بعنوان عربي اختياري، ومعاينة GIF وWebP، وملف export.json. / From one master: a reframed variant per ratio, a titled poster JPG, GIF/WebP previews and export.json.
how: `python3 scripts/kmotion.py export FILM.mp4 --out deliver --aspects 9:16,1:1,16:9 --title "…" --gif --webp` (kosif-studio `tools.py export … --poster 2.0 --mode smart --parallel 2`). Verified here: produced _9x16.mp4, _1x1.mp4, _poster.jpg, .gif and .export.json.
params: GIF 12 fps / 480 px / 160 colours / bayer scale 4 / 8 s · WebP 15 fps / 540 px / q70 / 8 s

what: يكتب الكابشن والوسوم وعنوان يوتيوب ووصفه والدعوة وأول تعليق ونص الغلاف والنص البديل، ثم يفحصها بحدود كل منصة وملاءمة الفيديو. لا ينشر. / Writes caption, hashtags, YouTube title/description, CTA, first comment, cover text and alt text, then lints them against each platform and the video fit. Never posts.
how: `python3 social.py pack FILM.mp4 --platforms tiktok,reels,shorts --topic "…" --out X.post.json` then `social.py check X.post.json` (exit 0 = ready). Lints: X weighted length (emoji 2, URL 23), YT title ≤100 (warn >70), hashtag caps (IG 5, YT >60 voids all, Threads 1), Arabic-normalised duplicate tags, hook before "more", dead links, CTA, alt text. Verified here: pack + check ran on a TikTok file (it flagged items as not ready — a draft to fill, not a final caption). Basma has the in-app version (5 Arabic hook titles ≤6 words, postPack JSON, POST_LIMITS) — needs its key-backed agent.
params: X 280 weighted · YT title ≤100 · IG 5 tags · Threads 1

what: حدود الحروف والوسوم وما يظهر قبل «المزيد» والمدة والنسبة والكاروسيل لتسع منصات. / Caption, hashtag, visible-before-more, duration, ratio, size and carousel limits for nine platforms.
how: `python3 social.py limits [--platform tiktok|reels|instagram|shorts|youtube|facebook|x|linkedin|threads]` (ran here; WhatsApp is not in this table — use platforms.py). Default posting slots (heuristic local time): tiktok 21:00, reels 20:00, instagram 13:00, shorts 18:00, youtube 17:00, facebook 19:00, x 12:00, linkedin 09:00, threads 12:00 — overridden by besttime.
params: tiktok 4000 chars/600 s/35 photos · reels 2200/5 tags/125 visible/180 s · IG 4:5 carousel 20 · FB 63206 · X 280/140 s/4 images · LinkedIn 3000/210 visible

what: وسوم إنستغرام: عام + اثنان متخصصان + مكان + علامة؛ والعربية بلا تشكيل ولا تطويل وبشرطة سفلية؛ والخطاف يطابق أول ثانيتين. / IG tags 1 general + 2 niche + 1 place + 1 brand; Arabic tags without tashkeel/tatweel; hook matches the first 2 s.
how: Hook = number / result / question / contradiction that the first 2 s of video actually show; one CTA (save / share / comment word / follow); one punchy non-corporate share line for X/LinkedIn/Discord drafted in planning, finalised at delivery (brag).

what: نصوص الشاشة في كتالوج منفصل عن التايملاين، ورندر لكل لغة مع تبديل الاتجاه. / On-screen strings in a catalogue separate from the timeline; one render per locale with RTL/LTR switching.
how: Scene JSON with string keys → per-locale renders; lock brand names in a glossary; validate placeholders/ICU before import; translation memory fuzzy 75–100% via XLIFF; re-fit text after translation (Arabic vs English length differs); pair with ARAB-08 content-language switch.

what: مئات النسخ المخصصة (اسم، سعر، مدينة) من قالب واحد بصفوف متغيرات. / Many personalised outputs from one template, one row of variables each.
how: `npx hyperframes render --batch rows.json --output "renders/{name}.mp4"` (cloud/lambda variants take JSONL); KOSIF equivalent: loop mtemplates.py `--set key=value` per row and render each.

what: التقاط حتمي للإطارات ثم ترميز ffmpeg إلى MP4/WebM/MOV/GIF/PNG/HLS بدرجات جودة. / Deterministic capture + ffmpeg encode to MP4/WebM/MOV/GIF/PNG/HLS with quality tiers.
how: npx hyperframes render [--quality draft|looks|delivery] [--fps 24|30|60] [--format mp4|webm|mov|gif|png-sequence|hls] [--crf 0-51 | --video-bitrate 10M] [--workers auto] [--docker] [--strict]. Defaults 30 fps; looks = CRF 16; GIF ≤30 fps (15 preferred); HLS 4 s; ≈256 MB RAM per worker. For KOSIF HTML pages the in-repo path is `node tools/render_html.cjs` (proven by the proof films).
params: looks CRF 16 · GIF 15 fps · worker ≈256 MB

what: يشارك الملف عبر قائمة مشاركة النظام مع الكابشن، أو يفتح صفحات الرفع في تيك توك ويوتيوب وإنستغرام وفيسبوك؛ لا ينشر وحده. / Shares the file through the system share sheet with caption, or opens upload pages; never posts by itself.
how: Basma share(): navigator.share({files,title,text}); links tiktok.com/upload, youtube.com/upload, instagram.com, facebook.com/reels/create.

what: خدمة Node تربط حساب واتساب وترسل نصًا أو صورًا أو فيديو أو صوتًا أو مستندًا لرقم. / Node service that links a WhatsApp account and sends text, images, video, audio or documents to a number.
how: kosif-audit-studio/whatsapp-container-v2: `npm install` then routes /connect (QR link), /status, /send, /send-media, /send-bundle; mimetype prefix picks message type; audio goes with ptt false. Needs the owner to scan the link QR — a personal account, not an API key.

name_en: Hosted private links & Cloudinary URL ops
what: رفع المشروع إلى رابط خاص ثابت، أو اشتقاق نسخ الفيديو من الرابط (قص، كتم، حد مقاس، WebP متحرك) في Cloudinary. / Publish a project to a stable private URL, or derive video variants by URL in Cloudinary.
how: `npx hyperframes publish [dir]` (hosted, republish updates the same link). Cloudinary: so_/eo_/du_ trim, ac_none for autoplay, c_limit,h_720, fps_, fl_splice, f_auto:animated previews — e.g. du_5/vc_auto/f_auto:video/q_auto. Both need accounts; locally use ffmpeg and the claude.ai artifact (FMT studio cloud) instead.

what: يحزم محرر الاستوديو كله في صفحة HTML مستقلة تعمل كـ artifact بلا خادم، والحفظ عبر قدرة التنزيل. / Bundles the whole Studio editor into one self-contained HTML page that runs as a claude.ai artifact; saves go through the downloads capability.
how: `python3 scripts/web/build_studio_cloud.py --out studio-cloud.html --home-url URL`: modules wrapped in IIFEs, imports rewritten, mp4-muxer@5.2.1 from cdn.jsdelivr.net, download() → window.claude.use("downloads").save(); save errors mapped (declined, too_large, rate_limited, rejected_extension). Verified here: built a 78,544-byte page.

name_en: Custom GPT / Claude Project packs & JSON envelope
what: تعليمات جاهزة و12 ملف معرفة وبدايات محادثة عربية وOpenAPI، وشكل JSON لتطبيقات AI Studio الخاصة بالمستخدم. / Ready instructions, 12 knowledge files, Arabic conversation starters and OpenAPI; a JSON answer envelope for the user’s own AI Studio apps.
how: Paste chatgpt/custom-gpt/instructions.md (3,999/8,000 chars), upload knowledge/*.md, import openapi.json with a Bearer token (29 action tools; MCP 65); Claude Project uses claude/project-instructions.md. JSON envelope only when the app parses JSON: {title, analysis, confidence, sources, json:{tool_output,prompts,imageSpecs}, nextSteps, qualityScore{…}} with per-platform {platform, prompt, negativePrompt, params{aspect}, audioDirection}.

name_en: Poster picked and baked as frame 0
what: يُختار إطار قوي مستقر (لا الرأس أو الذيل الأسود) ويُثبَّت كإطار أول حتى لا تظهر الصورة المصغرة سوداء، مع بقاء عدد الإطارات والصوت. / Pick a strong settled still (never the black head/tail) and bake it into frame 0 so thumbnails are not black; frame count and audio unchanged.
how: `python3 scripts/poster.py FILM --at 3.2 --bake` or poster.pick → extract → bake; brag recipe: overlay on the first frame only, -c:a copy (1/30 s at 30 fps). Verified by test_poster_pick_and_bake here.
params: 1 frame · audio copied · frame count unchanged

what: اسحب عينات من الفيديو كله، استبعد الفارغ والضبابي والانتقالات، ورشّح لحظات مختلفة تُظهر الموضوع أو النتيجة. / Sample the whole video, drop blank/blurred/transition frames, shortlist distinct moments showing subject or result.
how: ffmpeg -vf "select='gt(scene,0.3)',scale=640:-1" -vsync vfr, or thumbnail=n=100; score with numpy Laplacian variance (sharpness), face presence, contrast, placement; tile a contact sheet; when the piece is a composition, render the chosen moment natively. Animated cover = gentle loop with matching ends. YouTube bulk custom thumbnails ≲100 per channel per 24 h.

name_en: Arabic-titled cover from a film frame
what: يلتقط إطارًا عند ثانية محددة ويكتب عليه عنوانًا عربيًا مشكّلًا كصورة غلاف. / Grab a frame at a chosen second and write a shaped Arabic title on it.
how: `python3 scripts/kmotion.py thumb FILM --at 2 --text "…" --out cover.jpg` (studio recipe "thumb"); text is shaped by Pillow RAQM here. For designed thumbnails compose HTML/CSS and screenshot with Playwright at 1280×720.

name_ar: بريف الصورة المصغرة: 3 أفكار واختبار A/B
what: ثلاثة مفاهيم (تخطيط، تعبير، موضع النص، اللون، عناصر العلامة) مع توصية وخطة اختبار. / Three concepts with a recommendation, background-only image prompts, shooting notes and an A/B plan.
how: Shooting notes: slightly below eye level, medium close-up, one off-axis key light. Generate backgrounds without text (prompt template: subject with exaggerated emotion, high contrast, bold rim light, clean background, space on the right for title, 16:9) and composite the real face and the Arabic title as layers. A/B: vary one element, judge after 48 h by CTR vs channel average.

what: نص الغلاف 1–3 كلمات (4 حد أقصى)، ولون إبراز واحد، ولا تكرر أي كلمة من العنوان. / Thumbnail copy 1–3 words (4 max), one accent colour, and zero words shared with the title.
how: Must read in under 1 s at 150–200 px width; for Arabic count words not letters, heavy weights, no tracking. Title ≤60 chars with the key words in the first ~40; check overlap with a set intersection; produce 3 pairs at different angles (curiosity / benefit / identity). Basma cover text 2–4 words.

what: أغلفة وبطاقات روابط HTML+CSS تُصوَّر بالضبط 1200×630، بعنوان ≈40 حرفًا وخطين كحد أقصى. / Covers and link previews as HTML+CSS screenshots at exactly 1200×630, title ≈40 chars, ≤2 fonts.
how: Playwright screenshot of a fixed-size body with overflow hidden; direction by topic (technical = dark + accent gradients, tutorial = light and structured, conceptual = centred gradient type). Same approach yields 1280×720 thumbnails and 1080×1350 posts.
license: WTFPL folder in the atlas x* area — permissive, idea only.

name_en: Identity export set: favicon, PWA, OG
what: أقل مجموعة تصدير للهوية: favicon.svg وico، أيقونات التثبيت، وصور OG وX. / Minimum identity export: favicon.svg/ico, install icons, OG and X cards.
how: favicon.svg (dark via media query), favicon.ico 16/32/48, apple-touch 180×180, PWA 192/512, OG 1200×630, X 1200×675; render with headless Chromium or Pillow. Owner examples: earth tools/brand/make_marks.py renders icons from the SVG mark with theme_color #1d1814 (identity_unity test); audit-studio Arabic RTL manifest (lang ar, dir rtl, standalone, SVG any/maskable icons, theme #24113f).

name_en: Chart export PNG@2x / SVG + data-table toggle
what: كل رسم ينزّل نفسه SVG أو PNG مضاعف الدقة بالعنوان والمفتاح، ويتحول لجدول بيانات. / Every chart downloads itself as SVG or 2× PNG with legend/title baked in and toggles to its data table.
how: exportFig(fig, fmt): resolve CSS var colours with getComputedStyle, serialise SVG, draw into a canvas at k=2, canvas.toBlob("image/png"); fall back to SVG on error; PRINT_CSS hides tools.

name_en: Painter studio export modes (PNG · 4K · SVG · MP4)
what: من صورة واحدة: PNG، نسخة مطابقة، 3840×2560، SVG متتبَّع بطبقات اللون، برنامج بايثون، وفيلم MP4 للرسم. / From one picture: PNG, exact copy, 3840×2560 render or Lanczos enlargement, traced SVG, a Python program and an MP4 of the drawing.
how: Toolbar التصدير: 💾 PNG (Ctrl+S), ⤢ high-res (3840×2560, scale 3.2, ss=2), 📤 image code, 🎬 film (30 fps H.264); vectorize.to_svg(data, path, scale) writes one even-odd path per colour (scale 2 from the window, 4 from --trace).

what: الطباعة تخفي الأدوات وتفرض خلفية بيضاء ولوحة تراثية فاتحة، وتقارير بشكل ورقة، وإيصالات حرارية 80 مم بـ QR. / Print hides chrome and forces a light heritage palette; paper-style report previews; 80 mm thermal receipts and 60×40 mm labels with QR.
how: @media print: hide topbar/rails, panels break-inside:avoid, no shadows, body 11pt/1.6; earth print lock: ink #2b1a0f, brand #8a5a2b, Amiri / Noto Naskh / Aref Ruqaa. Paper preview: .paper bg #fcfbf7, padding 64px clamp(28px,6vw,78px), shadow 0 22px 60px #0008, brand header 800 weight / 3px tracking (Latin only) #5b376d. Receipts: qrcode.js with CorrectLevel.M, TLV invoice data.
params: 11pt/1.6 · 80 mm receipt · 60×40 mm label · QR ECC M

what: أي تقرير يتحول لشرائح ملء الشاشة: شريحة عنوان متدرجة ثم شريحة لكل قسم، بتنقل بالكيبورد. / Any generated report becomes full-screen slides: gradient title slide, one slide per h1/h2, keyboard navigation.
how: earth SK.output present(): slidesOf(doc) splits at headings; title slide linear-gradient(135deg,#0b1030 0%,#2a3fae 60%,#2340c4 100%); title clamp(22px,4vw,44px) 800. HyperFrames slideshow skill adds fragments, hotspots, branching sequences and presenter notes (npm install needed).

what: 6 ث = رسالة واحدة والعلامة ظاهرة بالثانية 2؛ 15 ث قابل للتخطي = الخطاف قبل زر التخطي عند 5 ث؛ 30 ث = قوس واحد يدفع مبكرًا ومتأخرًا. / 6 s bumper: one message, brand by 2 s; 15 s skippable: hook + core before the 5 s skip; 30 s: one arc, pay off early and late.
how: Template each length as a fixed timeline grid (markers at 2 s, 5 s, end card) and verify message placement on rendered stills at those times. Platform pacing (kosif-tool ads playbook): TikTok/Reels 9:16 15–30 s with cuts every 1–2 s; YouTube pre-roll key message before 5 s; feeds 1:1/4:5; ad structure hook 0–1.5 s, features 2–3 s each, CTA 2–3 s, logo 1–1.5 s.
params: 6 / 15 / 30 s · markers 2 s, 5 s · cuts 1–2 s

name_ar: نسخ مختصرة ومطولة من نص واحد
what: علّم كل نبضة بأولوية (أساسي/اختياري) لتتولد النسخ القصيرة بالتصفية وإعادة التدفق. / Tag each beat core/optional so cut-downs are generated by filtering beats and re-flowing the timeline.
how: Timeline/storyboard JSON beats with priority; regenerate 30 s and 15 s by dropping optional beats and re-timing to the same audio grid; re-check each version’s hook and CTA.

what: مصدر طويل واحد ← فيديو كامل + 3–5 مقاطع قصيرة + نسخ أصلية لكل منصة، بإصدار متدرج. / One long source → full video + 3–5 shorts + platform-native variants, released staggered.
how: Blog→video: H2s → chapters, stats/quotes → pull-quote overlays on B-roll, steps → tutorial segments, conclusion → short. Every derivative passes the standalone test (own hook and payoff, no "as discussed…"); list what was cut and why; channel specs: short video = 80–150 spoken words for 20–45 s, 3–5 beats each with an on-screen text cue, one CTA; YouTube description 200–500 words, first ~100 chars above the fold.
params: 3–5 clips per long piece · 80–150 words / 20–45 s

what: أطوال ومقاسات التريلر لكل منصة، والصامت يحمل رسالته بالترجمة. / Trailer lengths/specs per platform; muted autoplay means captions carry the message.
how: X/Bluesky/Mastodon 30–45 s 16:9 1080p60, hook within 2 s; YouTube 30–90 s; Shorts/TikTok/Reels 15–45 s native 9:16 with a big subject; README/Discord GIF loops 4–8 s at 640 px, 20 fps, <15 MB; store pages 60–120 s. Render native 9:16 rather than cropping when possible.

what: أول فصل عند 00:00، ثلاثة فصول على الأقل بفارق ≥10 ث، بأسماء أماكن أو أحداث قابلة للبحث. / First chapter at 00:00, ≥3 chapters ≥10 s apart, searchable names; also muxed as MP4 chapters.
how: Write the "mm:ss Name" list (hh:mm:ss past 60 min) for the description; mood words belong in captions, not chapters. To embed: ffmetadata [CHAPTER] blocks (TIMEBASE=1/1000, START, END, title=…) then ffmpeg -i in -i ch.txt -map_metadata 1 -map_chapters 1 -c copy. Verified here with Arabic titles read back by ffprobe -show_chapters.

what: الشريحة الأولى خطاف يعمل وحده، الثانية جسر، فكرة لكل شريحة، والأخيرة ملخص ودعوة؛ أقل من 5 = منشور واحد. / Slide 1 hooks alone, slide 2 bridges, one point per slide, last slide recap + CTA; under 5 slides → single post.
how: Instagram 5 min / 8–10 ideal, LinkedIn PDF 7–12, Facebook 5–8, all 1080×1350; title ≤8 words, body ≤30 words; reserve 80 px outer edge for pager; one progress signal (counter, bar or colour progression); one slide component with variants (cover, content, data, contrast, closing). Render with the Arabic carousel tool (ARAB-60: `social.py carousel spec.json --out DIR` → PNG + PDF + contact sheet). The same slide system animates into a 9:16 reel, one slide per beat.
params: 1080×1350 · title ≤8 w · body ≤30 w · 80 px edge

what: وصفات موقوتة: ثلاث بطاقات سريعة، سؤال يشق الشاشة، ثلاث نصائح بشريط تقدم، النتيجة أولًا، مقارنة بنصفين عادلين، ودعوة واحدة. / Timed recipes: three quick cards, question that splits the screen, three tips with progress, result-first, fair vertical split, one clear CTA.
how: MG-061: cards 0–0.9 / 0.9–1.8 / 1.8–2.7 s, topic 2.7–4 s, mask reveal per word. MG-062: question 0–1.5, split 1.5–2.5, answer 2.5–5 s (two masked frame copies move vertically). MG-063: tips 0–4/4–8/8–12 s, corner number, real progress bar. MG-066: result 0–2, shrink 2–3, steps 3–8, back 8–10 s. MG-067: labels 0–1, compare 1–6, summary 6–8 s with equal area, light and speed. MG-070: last shot shrinks 0–1 s, one CTA 1–4 s, never a fake tappable button.

what: العنصر الخارج في النهاية يدخل في البداية بنفس الموضع والسرعة، أو تذوب النهاية في البداية، ثم GIF بلوحة متكيفة. / The exiting element re-enters at the same position and speed, or the tail cross-fades into the head; then an adaptive-palette GIF.
how: Author a timeline where t=D equals t=0 and export frames 0..N−1 only; check with ffmpeg -stream_loop and a frame diff (brief: first/last identical, final hold only a 2% opacity breathe). Cross-fade variant: xfade=fade:duration=0.4:offset=D−0.8. GIF: palettegen=stats_mode=diff:max_colors=192, paletteuse=dither=sierra2_4a:diff_mode=rectangle, -loop 0; over budget → width 480 → fps 15 → 128 colours → shorter. Verified here: 6 s, 480 px, 15 fps, 128 colours ≈1.0 MB.

what: دعوة ومعرّف حساب وثلاث أيقونات تفاعل متتابعة وزر اشتراك ينضغط مرتين وشريط تقدم. / CTA, handle, three staggered social icons, subscribe pill that squashes twice and a linear progress bar.
how: `python3 scripts/mtemplates.py new NAME --template end-card --set cta="تابعنا للمزيد" --set handle=@kosif [--seconds 6 --size 1080x1920]` → projects/NAME/index.html (+fonts, gsap, motion-kit); render with motion.py. Verified by test_every_template_generates_and_lints.
params: 6 s · accent #E7B65A · bg #1b2a49 → #0d1b2a · bar linear over D−0.4 s
license: Uses GSAP — standard "no charge" licence, not MIT.

what: أيقونة واسم وسطر وصف وزر دعوة داكن مستدير وصف مزايا؛ أو عنوان قصير فوق شارتي App Store وGoogle Play. / Icon, wordmark, descriptor, dark rounded CTA pill and feature row; or a headline over equal App Store / Google Play badges.
how: Seen in style:pm-mehul4795-4a7007 (9:16, pale lavender #eceffa, CTA pill radius 24 px, features separated by red dots, small "BY …" credit). Registry block: `npx hyperframes add store-badge-lockup`, mount on a .clip div with data-composition-src/data-start/data-duration and data-variable-values (headline, showApple, showGoogle); extra duration becomes hold, never time-stretch. Square muted app ad brief: icon + name fully visible by 300 ms, last 500 ms frozen for the thumbnail, 80 px margin, text ≥48 px, headline ≥96 px.
params: pill r 24 px · visible by 300 ms · hold last 500 ms

name_en: Animated platform cards (follow, post, comment, now-playing)
what: بطاقات بشكل المنصات: متابعة تيك توك وإنستغرام وإكس، منشور إكس وريديت، تعليقات يوتيوب، شريط اشتراك، إشعار ماك، وبطاقة «يُشغَّل الآن». / Platform-style overlays: TikTok/Instagram/X follow, X and Reddit posts, YouTube comments, subscribe lower third, macOS notification, now-playing card.
how: `npx hyperframes add tiktok-follow | instagram-follow | x-follow-card | x-post | reddit-post | yt-comment-card | yt-lower-third | macos-notification | spotify-card` → compositions/<name>.html (inline SVG + paused GSAP 3.14.2 timeline). Sizes: follow cards 1080×1920 4.5 s, posts/notification 1920×1080 5 s, comments 8 s, lower third elastic.out(1,0.4) 4.5 s. Swap DM Sans/Inter for an Arabic face (ARAB-11) and set text direction per element. Use fictional handles or the user’s own — never impersonate real accounts.
license: Apache-2.0 registry; GSAP inside uses its standard licence.

what: سؤال ثابت عريض في الثلث الآمن العلوي، تحته عدّاد يتحدث مع الأحداث، وتعليمة صغيرة في الأسفل الآمن، وكبسولة «شغّل الصوت» أول 3 ث. / Fixed bold question in the top safe zone, a counter beneath that updates on events, tiny instruction at the bottom, a "sound on" pill for 3 s.
how: Question in the top 12–20% of 9:16; counter as tabular digits updated on event times (ARAB-73); "sound on" pill fades at 3 s; vertical ad variant puts the headline in the top third.

what: إعلان 1:1 مقروء بلا صوت، الكلام في الأعلى أو كتلة نص أعلى اليسار. / 1:1 promo legible without sound, captions on top or a top-left text block.
how: 1080×1080 (or 720×720 draft), captions top, text block top-left (top-right for Arabic), 80 px margins, product/hero bottom two-thirds; e-commerce ad structure: hook 0–1.5 s, promise, 2–4 feature beats 2–3 s, price card spring (damping 14, stiffness 180), CTA 2–3 s, logo 1–1.5 s, product ≥40% of frame height (`kosif.py scaffold ecommerce-ad <dir>`).

what: ثلاث بريفات جاهزة: «رحلة الإبداع» دودل 9:16 30 ث، إطلاق منتج 16:9 20 ث، «الشرح بطريقة الرسم» سبورة 9:16 45 ث. / Three ready briefs: doodle 9:16 30 s (ar-EG), product launch 16:9 20 s (en), whiteboard 9:16 45 s (ar).
how: Copy into project/brief.json and run `npm run plan`; deliverable = H.264 yuv420p +faststart CRF 19 MP4 + editable source, brief, storyboard and QA receipt (AGENTS.md step 9).

what: مهارات المالك للمتاجر والنشرات البريدية وهيكلة المحتوى للبحث — تخطيط مساند للفيديو لا أكثر. / Owner skills for e-commerce listings, newsletters and SEO architecture — planning support only.
how: Load the skill (SKILL.md + references/sources.md) and follow its numbered steps; instruction-only, no scripts.

name_ar: ماستر بلا صوت وملاحظة صادقة عن الصوت
name_en: Masters with a no-sound copy and an honest audio note
what: سلّم الماستر ومعه نسخة بلا صوت، وقل بوضوح إن الصوت فُحص بالأرقام لا بالاستماع. — Deliver the master plus a no-sound copy, and state plainly that the audio was checked numerically, not by listening.
when: تسليم فيلم إطلاق أو إعلان بصوت مؤقت — delivering a launch film or ad with a placeholder track.
how: Launch films: 1920×1080 30 fps H.264 with sub-frame motion blur + a _nosound master (the final sound is often made by a human in an editor). Brand masters: 1920×1080 24 fps H.264 High, BT.709, 20–30 Mbps, AAC 256k. Loudness target −14 LUFS / −1.2 dBTP, and the payoff line must stand clearly above the music (a −21 LUFS master with the payoff only +2.7 dB over music was not client-ready).
params: H.264 High BT.709 20–30 Mbps; AAC 256k; −14 LUFS / −1.2 dBTP
